chunks.cap: Do you know what page every AI model makes when you ask for a landing page?
Split hero. Heading left, picture right, one careful accent colour.
Yep. That was literally my page.
And honestly, that was me. I'd rewritten good design skills into one set of my own rules.
Each rule made sense. Together, every design came out the same.
So I stopped. Now each stage runs the original skill as it is.
And the first test STILL failed.
A fresh scorer gave the 3 options 8, 5 and 3 for AI look. Higher means less AI-looking.
And the test agent playing the client went straight for the 3.
So now anything under 7 gets rebuilt once or dropped.
Rerun: 7, 6, 7. The 6 got dropped. Stage passed.
